Report.title: Report
Report.description: A road sign damage report submitted by a community member.

imageUrl.description: Base64 encoded image data URL of the sign

severityScore.description: Severity of damage, on a scale of 1 to 5

userId.description: UID of the user who submitted the report

userName.description: Display name of the user who submitted the report

userEmail.description: Email address of the user who submitted the report

status.description: Resolution status set by municipal officials

resolvedBy.description: Name or email of the official who updated the status

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the complaint was marked as Work Done

/reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of all submitted damage reports
